brain_mri_multimodal.description: Standard BraTS 4-sequence cranial MRI co-registered and skull-stripped.

model_specification.required_preprocessing: Per-channel Z-score intensity normalization, SRI24 co-registration, skull stripping, and spatial sliding-window chunking (ROI 96x96x96, overlap 0.25).
model_specification.training_dataset_information: BraTS 2021 verified subset (40 train subjects, 10 fixed validation subjects).
model_specification.known_limitations: Requires all 4 co-registered multimodal MRI sequences (FLAIR, T1, T1ce, T2). Incompatible with CT Hounsfield data, non-brain anatomical structures, or single-sequence inputs.

ct_head.unsupported_reason: Active UNETR model is trained strictly for multimodal Brain MRI (FLAIR/T1/T1ce/T2). CT Hounsfield-unit data is incompatible with MRI intensity weights. AI prediction is withheld to prevent clinical hazard. Manual annotation, interactive voxel correction, and candidate dataset curation are fully supported.
ct_head.description: Cranial CT volumetric scan in calibrated Hounsfield Units (HU).

model_specification.expected_input_dimensions_and_channels: [1, D, H, W] calibrated HU volume
model_specification.required_preprocessing: Hounsfield windowing (Brain: C:40 W:80; Subdural: C:75 W:215; Bone: C:400 W:1800).
model_specification.training_dataset_information: No production CT segmentation dataset approved yet. Candidate dataset collection in progress via verified human corrections.
model_specification.known_limitations: No CT-trained model checkpoint deployed in current production registry. Inference withheld.

promotion_criteria.citation: Safe Medical AI Continuous Learning Guidelines (RANO / MedPerf continuous evaluation baseline criteria).
